device_entry.description: 一种通过 USB 连接的模块化实体控制面板，可包含按键、滑条和旋钮等输入部件，用于人工输入、设备控制和实验流程中的交互操作。
device_entry.description_en: A USB-connected modular physical control console that can include buttons, sliders, and rotary controls, used for manual input, device control, and interactive operation in laboratory workflows.
